task_title: Verify TJ-GAP-096 acceptance: foreign core.hooksPath shadow and /var/tmp/foreign-hooks residue both cleared
task_criteria: Clause 1 of the TJ-GAP-096 written acceptance: run `git config core.hooksPath` and `git config --global --get core.hooksPath` from the repository root — both must print no value and exit non-zero, proving no local, global or effective core.hooksPath shadows the repository's own .git/hooks (the 2026-10-22 leak was core.hooksPath=/var/tmp/foreign-hooks).

Clause 2 of the TJ-GAP-096 written acceptance — the surviving gate named in the row's blocked_reason: `test ! -e /var/tmp/foreign-hooks/pre-commit` exits 0. The leftover foreign hook directory recorded 2026-10-22 (dir mtime 2026-10-22 15:48:33 -0500, contents [pre-commit]) must be gone from the host.

The TJ-GAP-096 row in .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl at the judged commit carries a foreman_note recording the exact probe commands and observed results for clauses 1-2, the executable .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg trailer hook, and the trailer audit of the last three commits (3/3 carry exactly one Co-authored-by: Alexis Okuwa <wojonstech@gmail.com> trailer).

Live trailer check at the judged commit: `git log -3 --format=%b <judged-commit>` shows each of the three most recent commits carries exactly one Co-authored-by: Alexis Okuwa <wojonstech@gmail.com> line, and `test -x .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg` exits 0.
